issues.issue: Trim-wheel friction stack differs between drawing and count sheet.
issues.source: Plan21 shows bronze/split-lock washers; HK-TS4 calls three AN960-416.
issues.check: Confirm current factory friction stack; inventory is shown separately.

issues.issue: Complete trim cable route, length and adjustment not released.
issues.source: Plan22 linkage; HK-TS4 supplies rod ends but no completed adjustment. The 2019 Q1 p2 trim-tension notice predates and does not name the Companion; its numerical tension is not adopted.
issues.check: Verify both tab directions, stops, cable route and rod adjustment with current kit.

issues.issue: Factory-kit bolted outboard trim arms may develop play; the newsletter recommendation does not identify an exact compound grade or establish this kit's joint.
issues.source: 2022 Q2 p4, Mark Goldberg: outboard arm-to-tube joint, surface cleaning and red Loctite recommendation before bolt installation.
issues.check: Confirm the delivered bolted-versus-welded joint, current factory treatment/compound and fastener stack. Check both arms for play and preserve inspection access. Do not apply compound to rotating supports or rod ends.
